### CVE-2000-0206
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2000-04-25 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None

- Exploit-DB 19794: Oracle8i Standard Edition 8.1.5 for Linux Installer - Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2000-03-05, verified=1)

The installation of Oracle 8.1.5.x on Linux follows symlinks and creates the orainstRoot.sh file with world-writeable permissions, which allows local users to gain privileges.
